result.stdout:
OpenAPI specification diff (a .NET port of oasdiff)

Usage:
  oasdelta [command]

Compare two specs:
  breaking        Display breaking changes
  changelog       Display changelog
  diff            Generate a diff report
  summary         Generate a diff summary

Reference:
  checks          Display checks
  schema          Display the JSON Schema of the JSON output

Additional Commands:
  help            Help about any command

Flags:
      --config string   path to config file (overrides .oasdelta.* / .oasdiff.* lookup; can also use the OASDELTA_CONFIG or OASDIFF_CONFIG env var)
  -h, --help            help for oasdelta
  -v, --version         version for oasdelta

Use "oasdelta [command] --help" for more information about a command.
